title: RequirementPatch
description: Output of the extraction model for ONE teacher message. It is a proposal: the backend validates and merges it (domain/patch_merger.py). The model never produces chatbot text and never sets confirmation. Mirrors services/api/app/schemas/patch.py (Pydantic is authoritative; keep in sync).

user_intent.description: What the teacher is doing in this message, as understood by the model. Code decides what to do with it.

participants_mentioned.description: Raw counts found in the message. Code computes the total; the model must not add numbers itself unless the teacher states a total.

total_stated.description: Only when the teacher explicitly states a total ('nous sommes 30', '30 en tout')

operation.description: set = field was unknown; replace = teacher explicitly corrects a known value; clear = teacher withdraws a value ('je ne connais pas encore la date').

value.description: Shape depends on field: integer for participants_count; PartialDateTime for departure/return; TeachingType for teaching_type; null for clear.

evidence.description: Verbatim French fragment supporting the operation

PartialDateTime.description: Date and/or time as resolved from the message. Relative dates are resolved by the model ONLY when unambiguous given the provided current date; otherwise the field stays null and an ambiguity is reported.

detail.description: Short English explanation for the dialogue manager; never shown to the user

Conflict.description: New information contradicts existing state without an explicit correction. Code asks the teacher which is right.
